# `sim_engines`

**Tier reference** — project-independent, versioned by vintage rather than by project · owned by `engine` · `public.sim_engines`

**One row is** One row per simulation engine the platform knows: whether dispatch may use it (`status`) and which build the worker last reported running. scsim is the one active engine; the legacy worker engine is registered RETIRED — it stays frozen (CLAUDE.md's standing law) and is never offered. A run row names its engine (`simulation_runs.engine_id`) and the build is part of its RunKey.

## Uniqueness

| Columns | Source | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `slug` | UNIQUE constraint | `sim_engines_slug_key` |
| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `sim_engines_pkey` |

**Natural key:** `slug` — the key this table's grain implies, and the
database ENFORCES it: `sim_engines_slug_key`. A re-upload of the same row updates
it rather than duplicating it.

## Constraints

These reject the row outright. A value that fails one of them does not arrive
partially or get corrected — the write fails.

| Constraint | Rule | Added by |
|---|---|---|
| `sim_engines_status_check` | `CHECK (status IN ('active', 'retired'))` | `20261001000009_engines_runkey.sql` |

| Constraint | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `sim_engines_slug_key` | UNIQUE | `UNIQUE (slug)` |

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | **no** — invariant `audit-actor` is not met here yet |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | 1 — **1 with no predicate** |

A registry, not project data: read by everyone through `sim_engines_read` (`USING (true)`, select only), written by no API role. Rows are seeded by the migration; the one runtime writer is `sim_engine_report`, executable by the service role alone (the worker, at boot), which updates the row the worker runs and never creates one. Not audited: a reference table whose rows change by migration, and whose one runtime write is a build report stamped with `reported_at`.

> **What the database actually permits is wider than the row above.**
> 1 policy here grants access with
> **no predicate at all** (`USING (true)`), so the capability named above is what the
> product intends to check, not what the database enforces:
>
> - `sim_engines_read` — `SELECT` to `anon`, `authenticated`
>
> See PLAN.md D28: the application runs as the
> `anon` role with no auth session and the anon key ships in the frontend bundle, so
> closing these is a migration with an auth model behind it rather than a policy edit.

## Columns

`CSV header` is the name the **user types**, which is not always the column name —
that gap is defect D21. A dash means the column has no CSV origin.

| Column | CSV header | Type | Unit | Required in CSV | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` 🔑 | — | `uuid` | — | — | The engine's id — what `simulation_runs.engine_id` and `model_validations.engine_id` reference. |
| `slug` | — | `text` | — | — | The engine's stable name: `scsim`, `legacy-worker`. The worker reports under it; `_engine_for_code_version` maps a recorded code version to it. |
| `name` | — | `text` | — | — | The display name the Lab's engine selector shows (WP 10.5). |
| `version` | — | `text` | — | — | The engine's version as the worker last reported it (scsim's `ENGINE_VERSION`). NULL until a worker has reported — the registry does not restate a version the engine's own code authors. |
| `code_version` | — | `text` | — | — | The build string, spelled exactly as a run's `code_version` is stamped (`scsim-0.2.8`). Part of every RunKey: a new build makes a new key, so a run on another build is never offered as identical (§4 D245). |
| `status` | — | `text` | — | — | `active` (dispatch may use it) or `retired` (dispatch refuses it). |
| `capabilities` | — | `jsonb` | — | — | What the engine can do — where it computes (`worker`, `browser`) and its replication limit. Declared at seed; a report may refresh it. |
| `reported_at` | — | `timestamp with time zone` | — | — | When a worker last reported this engine's build. NULL = never reported. |
| `created_at` | — | `timestamp with time zone` | — | — | When the row was seeded. |
